info.name: Data AVAX Supply EVM Transactions API
List the latest transactions across all supported EVM chains

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 100.

params.name: network
params.description: Either mainnet or testnet/fuji.

params.name: status
params.description: A status filter for listed transactions.

items.docs: Lists the most recent transactions from all supported EVM-compatible  chains. The results can be filtered based on transaction status.

params.name: chainId
params.description: A supported evm chain id or blockchain id. Use the `/chains` endpoint to get a list of supported chain ids.

params.name: address
params.description: Contract address on the relevant chain.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency that return values should use. Defaults to USD.

items.docs: Returns a list of transactions where the given wallet address had an on-chain interaction for the given chain. The ERC-20 transfers, ERC-721 transfers, ERC-1155, and internal transactions returned are only those where the input address had an interaction. Specifically, those lists only inlcude entries where the input address was the sender (`from` field) or the receiver (`to` field) for the sub-transaction. items.docs:
Returns a list of internal transactions for an address and chain. Filterable by block range.

Note that the internal transactions list only contains `CALL` or `CALLCODE` transactions with a non-zero value and `CREATE`/`CREATE2`/`CREATE3` transactions. To get a complete list of internal transactions use the `debug_` prefixed RPC methods on an archive node.
